sources.title: Workflow syntax for GitHub Actions
sources.key_facts: permissions scopes: actions, attestations, checks, contents, deployments, id-token, issues, packages, pages, pull-requests, security-events, statuses; valid values: read/write/none; unspecified permissions default to none; concurrency.group + cancel-in-progress: true is valid combination; queue:max + cancel-in-progress:true is forbidden (validation error); defaults.run.shell valid values: bash/pwsh/python/sh/cmd/powershell

sources.title: Dependency caching reference - GitHub Actions
sources.key_facts: cache key max length: 512 characters; default repo cache limit: 10 GB; retention period: 7 days unused; rate limits: 200 uploads/minute, 1500 downloads/minute; correct key example: ${{ runner.os }}-build-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}; restore-keys from most to least specific

sources.title: Running variations of jobs in a workflow - GitHub Actions matrix strategy
sources.key_facts: matrix.exclude requires complete combination objects for matching; fail-fast default: true; max-parallel syntax: strategy.max-parallel: <integer>; include can expand or add configurations; exclude partial match supported

sources.title: Control the concurrency of workflows and jobs - GitHub Docs
sources.key_facts: concurrency.group: string or expression; cancel-in-progress: true/false; queue: single (default) or max (up to 100 pending); FORBIDDEN: queue:max + cancel-in-progress:true combination results in validation error; PR pattern: ${{ github.head_ref || github.run_id }}

sources.title: Assigning permissions to jobs - GitHub Actions
sources.key_facts: id-token: write required for OIDC JWT generation; permissions can be set at workflow or job level; write includes read; unspecified scopes default to none; contents: read typically needed alongside id-token: write for checkout

sources.title: Deprecation Notice - Upgrade to latest before February 1st 2025 (actions/cache Discussion #1510)
sources.key_facts: All versions prior to v3.4.0 and v4.2.0 deprecated; deadline February 1, 2025 (brownouts), final March 1, 2025; required versions: actions/cache@v4.2.0 or v3.4.0 minimum; non-compliant workflows will be automatically failed

sources.title: Notification of upcoming breaking changes in GitHub Actions - GitHub Changelog
sources.key_facts: Old cache service shutdown: April 15, 2025; runner minimum version for new cache: 2.320.1; FORBIDDEN to manually override ACTIONS_CACHE_URL, ACTIONS_RESULTS_URL, ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN; deployments:read no longer allows reviewing/approving deployments effective April 1, 2025 — must upgrade to deployments:write

sources.title: CI/CD YAML syntax reference | GitLab Docs
sources.key_facts: cache:key default value: 'default'; cache:key:files max 2 file paths, SHA computed from file content; cache:policy values: pull-push (default), pull, push; parallel:matrix creates job instances per variable combination; artifacts:expire_in valid formats: '42 seconds', '3 mins 4 sec', '2h20min', '6 mos 1 day', 'never'; interruptible default: false

sources.title: Caching in GitLab CI/CD | GitLab Docs
sources.key_facts: cache:policy pull for parallel jobs to reduce server load (should not use pull-push in parallel test jobs); same key + different paths causes cache overwrite; supports up to 4 caches per job; YAML example with cache key files: key.files array with Gemfile.lock and yarn.lock

sources.title: Make jobs start earlier with needs | GitLab Docs
sources.key_facts: Error when needs references excluded job: "'unit_tests' job needs 'compile' job, but 'compile' does not exist in the pipeline"; fix: add optional: true to the needs entry; syntax: needs: [{job: "name", optional: true}]; needs allows DAG execution independent of stage boundaries; needs: [] means start immediately
